idea-plugin.name: Claude Panel
idea-plugin.description: Dedicated tool window that runs an agent CLI (Claude Code, Ollama Claude or Ollama Pi), keeping the main Terminal tool window free. Works best with the Claude Code plugin installed: if Claude has taken over your Terminal window, launch it here instead — a side panel just for your AI sessions — and keep your main Terminal window free for the commands you actually run. Asks which command to run every time, and returns to the menu when the process exits.
